notes:
NFL Blitz for Nintendo 64, USA cartridge. Internal name 'NFL BLITZ', game code NBZE, 16 MiB, CIC-6102, boot checksum D094B170/D7C4B5CC.

TEAMS AND ROSTERS ARE MAPPED AND CONFIRMED. Both tables were located by string search and verified structurally: every roster pointer in the team table resolves exactly onto its own player block, all 480 jersey numbers are valid BCD, and the position codes line up with the real 1998 positions of every named player.

GAMEPLAY CONSTANTS ARE NOT MAPPED. Every entry below still has a null address and is marked 'undiscovered'. Finding them needs before/after dumps taken around a single in-game change -- see docs/DISCOVERING_ADDRESSES.md.

RAM to ROM mapping for this build: rom_offset = ram_address - 0x80241368. Derived from the 30 team roster pointers and confirmed against all of them. Useful with the Pointer Finder, which accepts a load base.

tables.name: Teams
tables.notes:
30 records of 0x40 bytes at 0x000A7CD8, ending at 0x000A8458. Verified by decoding every record: all 30 city/nickname pairs are the 1998 NFL, in alphabetical order by city, and every roster_pointer resolves exactly onto its own 0x5C0 roster block.

The five rating bars run 0..5. rating_passing and rating_rushing are identified with high confidence (every elite-QB team of the 1997 season -- Miami/Marino, SF/Young, GB/Favre, Denver/Elway, NE/Bledsoe, Dallas/Aikman -- scores 5 in the first, and Detroit/Barry Sanders scores 5 in the second, while Chicago and Indianapolis score 0 in the first). The remaining three bars are located and editable but their on-screen labels are not confirmed.

fields.name: City
fields.notes: NUL padded ASCII, e.g. 'Arizona'.

fields.name: Nickname
fields.notes: NUL padded ASCII, e.g. 'Cardinals'.

fields.name: City abbreviation
fields.notes: Three characters, e.g. 'ARZ', 'G.B'.

fields.name: Nickname abbreviation
fields.notes: Three characters, e.g. 'CAR'.

fields.name: Passing rating
fields.notes: Bar 1 of 5. Correlates strongly with 1997 quarterback quality.

fields.name: Rushing rating
fields.notes: Bar 2 of 5. Correlates strongly with 1997 running back quality.

fields.name: Team rating 3
fields.notes: Bar 3 of 5. Possibly receiving; label not confirmed.

fields.name: Team rating 4
fields.notes: Bar 4 of 5. Possibly defence; label not confirmed.

fields.name: Team rating 5
fields.notes: Bar 5 of 5. Possibly special teams; label not confirmed.

fields.name: Overall value
fields.notes: Ranges 3..11 and tracks 1997 team strength (Green Bay 11; Chicago, Indianapolis and St. Louis 3). Exact meaning unconfirmed.

fields.name: Unknown flag (0x3C)
fields.notes: 0 or 1, 13 teams zero and 17 one. Not conference. Meaning unknown.

fields.name: Roster pointer (RAM)
fields.notes: KSEG0 address of this team's 0x5C0 roster block. ROM offset = this value - 0x80241368. Editing this repoints the team at a different roster; leave it alone unless that is the intent.

fields.name: Reserved (0x0A)
fields.notes: Zero in all 30 records.

fields.name: Reserved (0x0C)
fields.notes: Zero in all 30 records.

tables.name: Players
tables.notes:
480 records of 0x5C bytes at 0x0009D070: 30 teams x 16 players, one 0x5C0 block per team, in the same order as the team table. Team membership is positional -- there is no team field -- so players cannot be reassigned by editing a value.

Slots are fixed by role: 0-2 offensive line, 3 quarterback, 4-6 skill players, 7-9 defensive line, 10-13 linebackers and defensive backs, 14-15 kickers. 270 of the 480 carry real names; the linemen are anonymous.

Jersey numbers are binary-coded decimal: 0x22 is 22, not 34. Verified against all 480 records (every one is valid BCD) and against known 1998 numbers -- Aikman 0x08, Emmitt Smith 0x22, Irvin 0x88, Favre 0x04, Rice 0x80.

The 24 bytes from +0x44 to the end of each record are zero in all 480 records and are not declared.

fields.name: First name
fields.notes: NUL padded ASCII.

fields.name: Last name
fields.notes: NUL padded ASCII.

fields.name: Jersey number
fields.notes: Binary-coded decimal.

fields.name: Position
fields.notes: Confirmed by cross-checking named players against their real 1998 positions: TE covers Shannon Sharpe, Tony Gonzalez and Ben Coates; K covers Morten Andersen and Matt Stover; CB covers Rod Woodson and Aeneas Williams.

fields.name: Portrait / head ID
fields.notes: Non-zero only for star players, who had scanned faces. 0 means a generic head.

fields.name: Has real identity
fields.notes: 1 for every record carrying a name, 0 for the anonymous linemen.

fields.name: Skill slot
fields.notes: 4=QB, 5=RB, 6=WR1, 7=WR2 on offence; 0 elsewhere.

fields.name: Model scale
fields.notes: 1.05 in all 480 records. Almost certainly the player model size multiplier, but since nothing in the ROM varies it, the effect is untested.

tables.name: Cities (upper case)
tables.notes: A second, upper-case city table at 0x000A8468, same order as the team table, used where the game needs a short all-caps name. Note three entries differ from the team table's city field: 'N.Y. GIANTS', 'N.Y. JETS' and 'SAN FRAN.'.

tables.name: Texture table
tables.notes: Not yet located. The ROM is 32% printable bytes, which suggests most assets are compressed or packed in archives; a filename table referencing Midway .wms assets sits around 0x00124C60 and is probably the way in.
